2027-01-13.title: Wednesday of the First Week in Ordinary Time
readings: He had to become like his brothers and sisters in every respect
The Lord remembers his covenant for ever
He cured many; in the morning he went out to pray
2027-01-13.alt: Weekday of Ordinary Time, Week 1 (Year I). Liturgical colour: green. Optional memorial: St Hilary, bishop and doctor.
2027-01-13.verse: In the morning, while it was still very dark, he got up and went out to a deserted place, and there he prayed.
theo: Mark shows us a full day in the life of Jesus. After the synagogue he enters Simon's house, where Simon's mother-in-law lies sick with fever. “He came and took her by the hand and lifted her up. Then the fever left her, and she began to serve them.” Healing becomes service. At sunset the whole town crowds at the door, and Jesus cures many. Then, “In the morning, while it was still very dark, he got up and went out to a deserted place, and there he prayed.” The secret of his day is his night prayer.

Hebrews explains why the Son came so close: he shared our flesh and blood “so that through death he might destroy the one who has the power of death, that is, the devil, and free those who all their lives were held in slavery by the fear of death.” He became like us in every respect to be a merciful high priest. “Because he himself was tested by what he suffered, he is able to help those who are being tested.” St Hilary of Poitiers, a married convert who became bishop, defended the divinity of Christ in exile; he knew both trials and the Lord who helps in them.
outline: Ask: what does a full day of yours look like? Where does God fit?
He was tested and can help us.
live: Give the first ten minutes of tomorrow morning to prayer before checking your phone.
After any blessing you receive this week, serve someone in thanks.
2027-01-13.prayer: Lord Jesus, you took Simon's mother-in-law by the hand and lifted her up, and before dawn you prayed to your Father. Lift me up from what weighs me down, teach me to pray, and help me in every test, for you were tested as I am. Amen.
altar: Jesus' prayer before dawn flows into every Mass, where he prays to the Father for us. We join his prayer and are lifted up to serve.

quick: Jesus lifts up the sick woman, and she serves.
Tested like us, he is able to help us.
2027-01-13.action: Give the first ten minutes of tomorrow morning to prayer.
2027-01-13.question: Where is the deserted place where I meet God each day?

family.explain: Jesus healed Peter's mother-in-law, and she got up and served everyone. Early the next morning Jesus went to a quiet place to pray.
family.intention: We pray for the sick in our family and neighbourhood.
family.ask: Ask: “When can our family pray together quietly each day?”

illus: A busy mother of four in Kottayam rises fifteen minutes before her household every morning. She sits by the window with her Bible and a cup of tea. She says: if I do not start with Jesus, the day runs over me; if I do, I can run the day.

pm.open: Lord Jesus, you went out before dawn to pray. Draw us into your prayer now, and lift us up as you lifted the sick. Amen.
share: He took her by the hand and lifted her up (Mark 1:31). From what do I need Jesus to lift me?
In the morning he went out and prayed (Mark 1:35). How do I protect time for prayer?
He was tested and can help those who are tested (Hebrews 2:18). What test am I facing?
interc: For the sick and those who care for them.
For those who serve in hidden ways after being healed.
For all who struggle to find time to pray.
For those afraid of death, that Christ may free them.
For our group, that our prayer may be faithful.
pm.close: Father, your Son healed the sick and prayed in the night. Lift us up, teach us to pray, and help us in every test. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.

homily: Dear friends, today's Gospel shows us a full day in the life of Jesus. After teaching in the synagogue he goes to Simon's house, where Simon's mother-in-law is in bed with a fever.

He came and took her by the hand and lifted her up. Then the fever left her, and she began to serve them (Mark 1:31). The first thing she does with her new strength is serve. Healing leads to service.

At sunset the whole town gathers at the door, and Jesus cures many. Then: in the morning, while it was still very dark, he got up and went out to a deserted place, and there he prayed (Mark 1:35). Jesus' busy day rests on his night prayer.

Hebrews tells us why he came so close: he became like us in every respect, so that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest. Because he himself was tested by what he suffered, he is able to help those who are being tested (Hebrews 2:18).
Today we remember St Hilary, who defended faith in Christ even in exile. Let us ask for Jesus' habit of early prayer, and let him lift us up to serve. Amen.
kids: Children, Jesus prayed very early in the morning, while it was still dark. Tomorrow, say a little prayer to Jesus as soon as you wake up!

intro: Theme: “In the morning, while it was still very dark, he got up… and there he prayed.”
Healing that leads to service, prayer that sustains, a priest who understands.

sub: He takes her by the hand.
q: O LORD my God, I cried to you for help, and you have healed me.
He came and took her by the hand and lifted her up. Then the fever left her, and she began to serve them.
points.apply: Serve someone today in thanks for a blessing.

q: O LORD, in the morning you hear my voice; in the morning I plead my case to you, and watch.
In the morning, while it was still very dark, he got up and went out to a deserted place, and there he prayed.
points.apply: Pray before you touch your phone each morning.

sub: He shared our flesh and blood.
He frees us from the fear of death.
He helps those who are tested.
q: He was despised and rejected by others; a man of suffering and acquainted with infirmity; and as one from whom others hide their faces he was despised, and we held him of no account.
Because he himself was tested by what he suffered, he is able to help those who are being tested.
points.apply: Bring your present trial to Jesus by name.

concl: Jesus' power flows from his prayer.
He who was tested lifts us up to serve.
2027-01-13.resolve: Keep a morning prayer time all this week.
